title: John Spytek on Fernando Mendoza: His time is coming, but he's got to earn it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Spytek on Fernando Mendoza: His time is coming, but he's got to earn it
sources.description: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak hasn't made it official, but all indications have been throughout the offseason and training camp that Kirk Cousins will open the season as starting quarterback — despite the club drafting Fernando Mendoza at No. 1 overall.
